# ihsm

An idiomatic hierarchical state machine package for TypeScript.

The **tutorials** are documentation pages with embedded playgrounds: pick a sender and message, send
events, and read the live dispatch trace on the same page. Every tutorial also has a matching Mocha
spec under `tutorials/*/tutorial.spec.ts`.

## Quick start

```bash
nix develop
nix flake check          # build + unit/tutorial tests
npm run doc:preview      # Docusaurus dev server
```

- [Reference manual](/reference) — concepts, semantics, API overview
